en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  The  Holy  Prophet  (s.a.w.s.)  said,  “One  who  frees  a believing  slave  for  the  sake  of Allah,  for  each part of the body of that slave, the Almighty Allah will keep the parts of his body safe from the fire of Hell. If that slave is a woman for every two parts of the body of that woman, the Almighty Allah will keep a part of his body safe from the fire of Hell. Surely a woman is half that of a man.”
